2752/// Returns the index pointer for code point `code` in this index.
2753#[inline]
2754pub fn backward(code: u32) -> u16 {
2755    let offset = (code >> 6) as usize;
2756    let offset = if offset < 1022 {BACKWARD_TABLE_UPPER[offset] as usize} else {0};
2757    BACKWARD_TABLE_LOWER[offset + ((code & 63) as usize)]
2758}
